purpose: Release and download dates of the register files behind the displayed facts, with the evidence for each. Read by scripts/export_register_facts.py. A date applies only to the file whose SHA-256 is given here; a different file needs a new entry.

repd.release_evidence: GOV.UK publication page for the Renewable Energy Planning Database: its update log entry of 3 August 2026 reads 'Updated the Renewable Energy Planning Database (REPD) for July 2026', and the page lists this file as the Q2 2026 edition.
repd.download_evidence: The earliest local copy of this exact file (same SHA-256) was created on 2026-08-25. A second copy created on 2026-08-29 carries a download record from assets.publishing.service.gov.uk.

neso_tec.release_evidence: NESO publishes this dataset twice weekly and names each file by its date (for example tec-register-16-october-2026.csv). This copy is dated 10 October 2026 in its file name, and the notes written when it was downloaded describe it as the 'status of 10 Oct 2026'.
neso_tec.download_evidence: The notes written when the NESO files were downloaded are dated 2026-10-13, and the earliest local copy of this exact file (same SHA-256) was created on 2026-10-13.

neso_embedded.release_evidence: NESO publishes this dataset twice weekly and names each file by its date (for example embedded-register-16-october-2026.csv). This copy is dated 10 October 2026 in its file name.
neso_embedded.download_evidence: The notes written when the NESO files were downloaded are dated 2026-10-13, and the earliest local copy of this exact file (same SHA-256) was created on 2026-10-13.
